title: Work budget
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\tau\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\tau\leq 1$. Define the work budget as $n$ times the sum of the controller step-work bound and twice the active cap at threshold $\tau$ times eight times one more than the Fourier-estimator sample count, multiplied by $n+1$; the sample count uses the weight-accuracy and call-confidence parameters specified by $n$ and $\tau$.
caveat: The controller-work, active-cap, accuracy, confidence, and sample-count functions are referenced but not defined in the supplied definitions.
